https.d: The whole site on HTTPS, a 301 from every HTTP address to its HTTPS equivalent, and one version of the domain (with or without www).

titles.d: A 50–60 character title, specific to each page, editable from the site's admin.

descriptions.t: A unique meta description per page
descriptions.d: 120–155 characters, specific to each page and editable from the admin.

headings.t: One H1 per page and ordered headings
headings.d: An H1 that states the page's subject, then H2s and H3s in order, in the HTML without waiting for JavaScript.

canonical.d: Every page declares its canonical address, without tracking parameters, in the initial HTML.

indexing.d: A robots.txt that blocks nothing useful and names the sitemap, an up-to-date generated sitemap.xml, no noindex on pages meant to rank.

structuredData.d: JSON-LD suited to the business (Organization or LocalBusiness, BreadcrumbList, and Product, Article or FAQ where relevant).

mobile.d: Meta viewport tag, a layout built for phones, tap targets of at least 48 px.

language.d: A lang attribute on every page's html tag, and hreflang if the site exists in several languages.

images.d: Alt text on meaningful images, modern formats (WebP or AVIF), declared dimensions, lazy loading below the fold.

social.d: Open Graph tags (title, description, image) on every page, favicon and app icons.

errors.d: A custom 404 page that does return 404, no broken internal links, no redirect chains.

security.d: HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options or CSP frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy.

content.d: The current pages' text is carried over or improved, never cut without reason; thin pages are expanded.

redesignSpec.s6Hint: Measured by the audit on the homepage, on mobile. Google's "good" thresholds.
redesignSpec.s7Hint: Every current address keeps its address or redirects with a 301 to its new page. Fill in the "New address" column with the development team.
redesignSpec.pagesNone: No known pages: the audit gave no inventory.
